issue.title: inclusive-clamp
issue.body: clamp should include the upper bound: clamp(12, 0, 10) should return 10, not 9.

classification.summary: clamp should include the upper bound: clamp(12, 0, 10) should return 10, not 9.

diff:
--- a/bounds.py
+++ b/bounds.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def clamp(value, lower, upper):
-    return min(max(value, lower), upper - 1)
+    return min(max(value, lower), upper)
